principle_sentence: Scene 1 must read as a schematic demonstration of displacement, and scene 2 must read as socially directed ridicule with visually integrated speech bubbles.

principle_semantic.notes: v4 aims to make the principle-supporting visual language match the overlays rather than conflict with them.

physical_causal.notes: Scene 1 now uses authored overflow cues instead of model-led fluid motion; scene 2 removes projectile physics entirely.

style_coherence.notes: Scene 1 base was stylized downward to harmonize with simplified overlays.

overlay_integration.notes: Scene 2 bubble styling and mouth anchoring were redesigned.

readability_timing.notes: Bubble reveals are staggered and held longer; title boxes remain readable.

chosen_fix_strategy: For scene 1, stylize the base down to match the schematic action. For scene 2, refine the bubble system rather than changing the full background scene.
